Extract Palette or Ramp Function

Source: R/colortheme_utility.R
as_palette.Rd

as_palette() and as_ramp() extract the underlying discrete palette function or continuous color ramp function from a color theme or color kernel.

Usage

as_palette(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'colortheme'
as_palette(x, ...)

# Default S3 method
as_palette(x, ...)

as_ramp(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'colortheme'
as_ramp(x, ...)

# Default S3 method
as_ramp(x, ...)

Arguments

x

a "colortheme" object, a theme name (character string), a color vector, or a color-generating function.

...

additional arguments passed to colortheme to modify the theme before extracting the function.

Value

  • as_palette() returns a palette function taking an integer n and returning n colors.

  • as_ramp() returns a ramp function taking a numeric vector x in [0, 1] and returning corresponding colors.

See also

colortheme

Examples

pal <- as_palette("Okabe-Ito")
pal(8L)
#> [1] "#000000" "#E69F00" "#56B4E9" "#009E73" "#F0E442" "#0072B2" "#D55E00"
#> [8] "#CC79A7"

ramp <- as_ramp("Viridis")
ramp(c(0, 0.5, 1.0))
#> [1] "#4B0054" "#009B94" "#FDE333"
